user_welcome.title: User Account Created (Welcome Email)
user_welcome.subject: Welcome to ShopX Global, {name}!
user_welcome.content:
SHOPX GLOBAL

GLOBAL PROCUREMENT & LOGISTICS

Welcome aboard, {name}!

Thank you for creating your account on ShopX Global. Your registered email address is {email}.

You can now explore our global marketplace, deposit funds into your virtual wallet, place orders, and track shipments in real-time.

Log In to Your Account

If you did not create this account, please contact support immediately.

order_confirmation.title: Order Made (Confirmation)
order_confirmation.subject: Order Confirmation #{order_id} — ShopX Global
order_confirmation.content:
SHOPX GLOBAL

Order Received!

Hello {name}, thank you for your order!

Order Number: #{order_id}

Order Total: {total}

Tracking Code: {tracking_code}

Shipping Address: {shipping_address}

We are preparing your items for shipment. You can track your order status anytime in your dashboard.
